views.label: Full System Flow
views.note: Primary user requests, terminal integration, and persistent SQLite database.

views.label: Payroll & Calculation Engine
views.note: Attendance aggregation, explicit absence preservation, off-day tracking, and daily proration.

cards.title: Client & Terminal
items: React 19 SPA with live Attendance, Employee, and Payroll Management
Inter Google Font typography standard applied across all UI and print views
A5 Half-A4 printable documents (148mm × 210mm) at 300 DPI print quality

cards.title: Engine & Business Rules
items: Day-wise monthly proration with integer daily rate: perDayRate = Math.round(base_salary / daysInMonth)
Daily Come, Daily Pay: daily workers paid per shift with 1-day rate vouchers
Explicit absence preservation ensures recorded absences are never reduced

cards.title: Security & Governance
items: Super-admin password gate required for employee reactivation
Cascade deletion protection converts hard-deletes to soft-deletes
